description: Browse or search a connected storage. Required: root_id — roots[].id from list_file_accounts (the provider drive id works too). Optional: folder_id (browse inside a folder), query (search — the PROVIDER searches, so Drive also looks inside PDFs and Graph honours sharing), limit (default 50, max 200). Nothing is copied into CallPilotAI; you get metadata plus a link to the original.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_remote_files
